verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents an extensive versioned (v8) public REST API. It covers CRUD on records and modules, metadata discovery, COQL queries, GraphQL-style queries, composite and bulk write calls with callbacks, OAuth scopes, credit-limit headers, and official Python and Node SDKs. Together these let a programmatic or AI client fully drive the product. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (the probe found 404s at the common paths) and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.
